ERR_FLASHER_BUSY.message: The attached board is being flashed already

ERR_FLASHER_BOARD_ID.message: This board has id 0, the id a newly flashed board starts with
ERR_FLASHER_BOARD_ID.hint: Give this board another id (SESSION ID) and restart it first.

ERR_FLASHER_NO_ANSWER.message: The attached board's ROM did not answer (op {op}; {bytes} bytes came on the line)
ERR_FLASHER_NO_ANSWER.hint: Check the cable: TX to U0RXD, RX to U0TXD, the BOOT and EN wires and the ground.

ERR_FLASHER_ROM.message: The attached board's ROM refused op {op} (error {code})

ERR_FLASHER_VERIFY.message: The flash of the attached board differs at {addr} from what was written

ERR_FLASHER_IMAGE.message: This board's own firmware can't be read
